title: 10 Best Khaya Senegalensis Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Khaya senegalensis are teas, decoctions, poultices, tinctures, and capsules, each offering unique benefits for traditional healing. Teas are commonly brewed from the leaves or bark to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. Decoctions involve boiling the bark or roots to extract potent compounds for treating fever and infections. Poultices made from crushed leaves are applied externally to heal wounds and relieve pain. Tinctures, created by soaking the plant in alcohol, are used for their antimicrobial and analgesic properties. Capsules provide a convenient form for internal use, often used to support immune function and manage chronic conditions.
